'''Oats''' are an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. They can only be [[milling|milled]] into [[flour|oat flour]] and cannot be [[brewing|brewed]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] oats for their ''beer'', regardless {{Bug|0008226}}.

[[File:Avena sativa L.jpg|thumb|center|300px|Admired for its ''beer''.]]

{{D for Dwarf}}Oats are frequently sold by balding, diabetic [[walrus man|walrus men]].
